```yaml
name: Pre-commit Bot

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_precommit:
        description: 'Run pre-commit hooks'
        required: true
        type: boolean

jobs:
  validate-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pygithub
  
      - name: Validate permissions
        id: validate_permissions
        run: |
          from github import Github
          g = Github(${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }})
          pr = g.get_repo('llamastack/llama-stack').get_pull(int(github.event.issue.pull_request.number))
          if pr.user.login != github.actor and not pr.user.permissions.admin:
            raise Exception("Only PR authors or repository collaborators can trigger the pre-commit bot.")

  dispatch-precommit:
    needs: validate-permissions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: "Pre-commit Execution"
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      
      - name: Dispatch pre-commit execution workflow
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/llamastack/llama-stack/dispatches \
            -d '{"event_type": "run_precommit"}'

  pre-commit-execution:
    name: Pre-commit Execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.run_precommit == 'true'
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install pre-commit
        run: pip install pre-commit
      
      - name: Run pre-commit
        run: pre-commit run --all-files
      
      - name: Commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: '.'
          commit: 'chore: auto-formatting by pre-commit bot'
          author_name: 'Pre-commit Bot'
          author_email: 'bot@pre-commit.com'
          push: true
```
